summary.plain: A laboratory built in a former gold mine in Lead, South Dakota. Nearly a mile of rock above it blocks cosmic rays, so experiments there can look for very rare events, including the giant DUNE neutrino detectors.
summary.technical: Underground laboratory operated by the South Dakota Science and Technology Authority in the former Homestake mine. The 4850-foot level (about 1500 m of rock, 4300 m.w.e.) hosts LZ, the Majorana Demonstrator, CASPAR and the LBNF/DUNE far-detector campus.
